purpose: Numerical replay of the incomplete case after a storage-monitor software fix; preserve the original failed attempt and cost
budget_rationale: The original second attempt consumed 265 primitives and 1300.6843819138594 seconds before an atomic-file monitoring race interrupted IRC. This one-case software-fix replay reserves 3300 seconds and 3000 primitives, within one GPU-hour, eight CPU-core-hours and 0.5 GiB. Numerical methods and tolerances are unchanged; this is a new finite stage, not a discarded or free retry. The successful first case is not rerun.
claim_limits: The case was originally selected for a known matched event, then replayed after an observed software fault; no performance or discovery-rate estimate is possible.
Only gas-phase neutral singlet CHNO is supported. No solution, CP2K, xTB, open-shell, or experimental claim.
Raw geometry and source verdicts remain on n2; public outputs contain hashes, aggregate diagnostics and event IDs.
New final-gradient checks and rejection of endpoint gray zones are versioned protocol changes, not retroactive edits to old certificates.
Storage is monitored every 0.1 seconds with per-file limits; it is not a filesystem quota and transient overshoot is possible. Overshoot blocks successful certification and must be reported.

retry_context.reason: FileNotFoundError during concurrent atomic-journal storage monitoring
